summary: Produced a compiling TikZ reconstruction (version 2, best version). It draws the circle centred at D (radius ~3.963 cm in the program's scale), the chord A–E–C, radii AD and CD, segments AB and CB–D (B on CD), and the perpendicular ED. Labels A, B, C, D, E are present. Version 2 received an automatic critic review: score 0.93, no issues, must_repair false. Visual inspection confirmed that the label at (293,78) is E, not F, and that there is no right-angle mark at E.
